svg.title: BGP EVPN programs the VXLAN FDB
svg.text: 16 · BGP EVPN programs the VXLAN FDB

g.text: iBGP EVPN (AS 65000) comes up over loopbacks; type-3 routes announce each leaf's VNI 100 membership.
The first ARP from h1/h2 lets each leaf learn its local MAC; EVPN type-2 routes then carry MAC/IP + VNI.
h1 pings h2: leaf1 already knows the h2 MAC from EVPN, so the frame is unicast into VXLAN — no flooding.
The reply returns the same way; FDB entries came from BGP (nolearning), not from data-plane flooding.
